title: MOT-VID-013 — 41 Generated Visuals / Three Hooks
summary: Solution-aware Motilli ad: three openings lead with familiar failed remedies, then a shared mechanism-first body introduces apigenin, soluble fiber and chlorophyllin before the product. The close pictures getting dressed, making plans and feeling like yourself again. 41 GPT Image 2 keyframes; approximately 95 seconds per version. Stills for review; motion and narration are next.
